summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of two changes: (1) new scroll-to-top button (data-testid='scroll-to-top-btn') and (2) Infos Pratiques header image overflow bug. All 11 requested checks PASS. Button is a <button type='button'>, present on / , /fbf_contact.php, /fbf_apropos.php, /fbf_decouverte.php, /fbf_infopratique.php, /fbf_mentionslegales.php, /accueil/fbf_accueil.php (all HTTP 200); hidden at top (no 'visible' class, opacity 0 + visibility hidden), becomes visible & in-viewport after scrollTo(0,1000), smooth-scrolls back to pageYOffset=0 on click and auto-hides again. Verified on desktop 1440 and mobile 390 (hit-test confirms button is topmost, not overlaid). Infos Pratiques header: image .size-image bottom = 500px @1920 and @1440 (<=550), 320px @900 (<=400), 243.8px @390 (<=300); first .atelier-titre ('Poney Éveil') always strictly below the image with gap 95-105px (in 30-200 range) - no overlap of 'Poney Éveil' / 'Équithérapie' / 'Séjours Équestre'. Regression on /accueil/fbf_accueil.php @1920: header image loads (naturalWidth 2048, rendered 1920x1081) and title "A ch'val au Bois Frican !" present - unaffected by body.infopratique rules. No console errors and no error-class elements found.

issues: Header title 'Infos Pratiques' sits directly over the panneau.jpg sign graphic; dark text on a busy mid-tone image reduces legibility (cosmetic only, not the reported overflow bug)

critical_code_review_comments: fbf_style_test.css around line 492-495: 'body.infopratique .scroll-arrow-container { display: none; }' is followed by an extra closing brace inside/after a media block - verify brace balance so later rules are not silently dropped (no visible impact observed in tests, but worth a cleanup).
Templatebase.php line 34 adds body class 'scroll-top-visible' for Ferme/Animaux/Ateliers titles, but no CSS rule uses it - dead code, remove or implement.
menu.js uses deprecated window.pageYOffset; window.scrollY is preferred (works today, minor modernization).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scroll-to-top button and Infos Pratiques header layout fully validated at 1920/1440/900/390 viewports. Only cosmetic mobile header-title contrast note remains. Tests were done via inline Playwright scripts (no persisted test file); PHP site served on port 3000 via preview URL.
rca_of_the_issue: Original overflow was caused by the unbounded header image height; the new body.infopratique .background-image aspect-ratio + max-height + object-fit: cover rules correctly bound the image (500/320/260px caps) so main content starts below it at every tested breakpoint.
